name: gesinn-it/qrlite
description: QRLite is a MediaWiki extension that renders QR Codes in SVG or PNG format

phpunit: bash -c 'extDir=$(pwd) && cd ${MW_INSTALL_PATH:-../..} && { [ -f tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php ] && { php tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; [ -f phpunit.xml ] || printf "%s" "<phpunit><!-- generatePHPUnitConfig --></phpunit>" > phpunit.xml; } || true; } && MEDIAWIKI_HAS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c "$extDir/phpunit.xml.dist" --bootstrap tests/phpunit/bootstrap.php --testdox'
phpunit-coverage: bash -c 'extDir=$(pwd) && cd ${MW_INSTALL_PATH:-../..} && { [ -f tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php ] && { php tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; [ -f phpunit.xml ] || printf "%s" "<phpunit><!-- generatePHPUnitConfig --></phpunit>" > phpunit.xml; } || true; } && MEDIAWIKI_HAS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c "$extDir/phpunit.xml.dist" --bootstrap tests/phpunit/bootstrap.php --testdox --coverage-text --coverage-html "$extDir/coverage/php" --coverage-clover "$extDir/coverage/php/coverage.xml"'
